Options:
  -run REGEXP  Select tests by regular expression
  -bench REGEXP  Select benchmarks
  -count N  Repeat tests
  -timeout DURATION  Set test timeout
  -cover  Enable coverage
  -coverprofile FILE  Write a coverage profile
  -json  Emit JSON events
  -failfast  Stop scheduling after a failure
  -o FILE  Set output path
  -v  List compiled packages
  -n  Print commands without running them
  -x  Print executed commands
  -race  Enable race detection
  -tags LIST  Set build tags
  -ldflags FLAGS  Pass linker arguments
  -gcflags FLAGS  Pass compiler arguments
  -mod MODE  Set module download mode
  -trimpath  Remove local paths from output
